definition: A script run in a worker thread by the working service. It receives data and returns a result.
One implementation of a service such as memory or redis. Chosen when the service is created.
The singleton that creates services and injects their dependencies.
An ordered list of activity steps run by the workflow service. Each step receives the previous steps' output.
A named first-in first-out list of jobs in the queueing service.
A named channel in the notifying service. Subscribers receive every message published to it.
A saved copy of in-memory state written to the filing service so it survives restarts.
A daily summary of new documents published to the digest.ready topic.
